name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.crash.CrashTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. As app screens resume, this BigBrother task registers a handler for uncaught crashes; when one occurs, the handler saves a report and opens the crash screen.
disableEffect: BigBrother will stop saving and showing crash reports; the app's existing crash handler remains in place.
